_comment: MA+R:R v9 1h walk-forward with SIX-MONTH out-of-sample blocks, run over the 2023-08 history backfilled for the 3-year test. This exists to resolve a contradiction: the 3-year holdout (24-month windows, backward direction) gave a +16.9% median with TAO/SYN/KAITO outstanding, while the original walk-forward (2-month blocks, forward direction) gave zero. Six-month FORWARD blocks test whether the edge is real but slow, or an artifact of testing backwards.
_sizing: FIXED $1000 per trade — qty_pct_equity forced to 0 in base_params, so leverage cannot flatter the result.
